summary: Typography verification across all 8 pages (Home, About, Mission, Mentorship, Volunteer, Prayer, Contact, Donate) on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Verified: (1) headings use Cormorant Garamond serif, (2) body uses Inter sans-serif, (3) nav links + mobile menu items are Inter font-weight 600 (semibold), (4) NO letters clipped anywhere including descenders (p, y, g, j, q) and italic gold accent words. Programmatic check of all h1-h4 elements across every page compared glyph-bottom (approx font-size*0.22 descender) against any overflow:hidden ancestor bottom edge — zero clip violations found. Scrolled to trigger mid-page section headings and re-checked post-animation.
critical_code_review_comments: Typography spec correctly implemented: index.css @import loads Cormorant Garamond + Inter (with weights 300/400/500/600/700); base layer applies serif to h1-h4 with line-height 1.1; body binds to Inter. Tailwind fontFamily.heading/body match. Layout nav links confirmed font-semibold Inter at 600.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3: Font swap to Cormorant Garamond (headings) + Inter (body/nav semibold) verified across all 8 pages, desktop + mobile. MaskedLines pb-[0.35em] -mb-[0.22em] fix from iter 2 still holds — no descender clipping observed for any hero heading (e.g., 'guide', 'young', 'hope', 'pray', 'you', 'young life', 'Truth'). All specific headings called out in the review request render fully: Home hero, Truth section, Mission, Mentorship, Prayer, Contact, Volunteer, Donate. Italic gold accent words (e.g., 'life.', 'from you.', 'hope.', 'to Christ.') render complete. Note: h1 font-weight varies (300 on /about, 500 elsewhere) — matches design and not a bug. No action items for main agent.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no issue found. Prior descender-clipping fix (Reveal.js MaskedLines with pb-[0.35em] -mb-[0.22em]) continues to prevent clipping under the new Cormorant Garamond serif at all heading sizes (72/60/48/36/30/24/16px).
